payload.note: scripts/cup20_trial.py and scripts/cup20_evaluate.py were proven end to end before any team was dispatched, against a throwaway candidate in a scratch team root and a scratch journal outside the repository. No trial_accepted record was written here: a test trial would consume a real team's budget AND permanently block quarantine.release_for_rebuild, which refuses once any accepted trial exists.

payload.purpose: Transparent baseline: does unshaped per-coin 45-bar own-price momentum, sized 1/own-vol with no declared controls, clear the floors at 7.5 bps a side
Signal shaping in isolation: four-rung horizon ladder plus soft trend threshold plus 9-boundary holding overlap, still with no declared controls, versus the unshaped baseline

Individual control: the same shaped signal with one declared control, a 10 percent annualised volatility target, which is the only thing that governs exposure during the common risk unit's own 90-day warm-up

Trial 7 cleared every floor but annualised turnover (27.80 against 25). Does slowing the ladder to two rungs at 1x and 2x formation and lengthening the holding overlap to 15 boundaries bring turnover inside the budget without giving back the Sharpe, the drawdown or the worst fold
Combined controls: does adding a two-step drawdown brake on top of the declared volatility target improve maximum drawdown or the worst fold enough to justify the exposure it gives up

The months end of the lane: the same construction with the ladder moved to 30 and 60 day rungs. The cell-level EDA said own-price persistence decays past about 45 days of formation and turns negative in folds F2 and F3; this asks the organiser's own scorer whether that holds at the portfolio level

Declared plateau sweep of the frozen nominee: each of the three coordinates varied one at a time by plus and minus 20 percent of the nominated value, a rule fixed in research step 9 before any of these points were measured

Exact sign inversion of the nominated point plus eight gross-edge placebos: if reversing every weight also clears the core floors the apparent edge is a construction artifact, and if a book that keeps the weight multiset and rebalance schedule but randomises which coin receives which weight earns the same gross edge then the per-coin signal is doing nothing
Does cross-sectional position inside a coin's own trailing quarter range, long the three highest and short the three lowest rebalanced weekly, clear the floors net of 7.5 bps a side?
x
Is the edge a property of the quarter-length channel specifically, or of channel position at any multi-week horizon? Same book at FORMATION_BARS=126 (six weeks).
Does requiring the level breach to be FRESH -- a new quarter extreme printed within the last 21 bars -- separate breaks that carry from breaks that snap back, i.e. improve the book?
Does range COMPRESSION -- a channel wide relative to current true range, i.e. a coiled coin -- separate breaks that carry from breaks that snap back?
Combined-control arm: do breach freshness and range compression together improve the book, even if neither does alone?
Declared neighbourhood sweep: is the channel-position book a plateau across formation 210/252/294 bars, rebalance 15/21/27 bars and phase 5/12/19, or a spike at the nominated point?

Falsification battery: does the exact sign inversion of the nominated point clear the core floors, and does a placebo that keeps the weight multiset but randomises which eligible symbol receives which weight reach the candidate's gross edge?
Does momentum admitted only when the standardised bar-run count clears a coin-flip null, sized by overlapping tranches and inverse volatility, clear the CUP-20 floors on the top-20 perpetuals?

Gate-removal ablation: identical code path with USE_GATE=0, so every control except the run-structure gate is retained. If the candidate performs comparably without the gate, the lane's mechanism is not what is producing the result.

Can the annualised turnover floor be cleared at all by this construction? Single-parameter change from #21: REBALANCE_EVERY 3 -> 9, holding quantities on eight of every nine boundaries. Establishes the Sharpe price of turnover compliance.
Transparent baseline: all three controls off (no run gate, equal weight, no net-exposure damping), same formation, smoothing and cadence. The reference every other run is read against.

Individual-control ablation: the run-structure gate added to the transparent baseline and nothing else, so the gate's own contribution is separated from inverse-vol weighting and net-exposure damping.

Third formation horizon: FORMATION_BARS 15 -> 45 (5 days -> 15 days) with the gate threshold held in standardised z units, testing whether the run-structure edge is horizon-general or specific to the short end.

Second rebalance horizon at the fast end: REBALANCE_EVERY=1, a target emitted at every 8h boundary with no held boundaries, which isolates how much of the turnover is drift correction rather than signal change.

Falsification battery on the strongest configuration: exact sign inversion against the core floors, plus eight gross-edge placebos that keep the weight multiset and rebalance schedule and randomise which eligible symbol receives which weight. Asks whether the run-gate edge is a construction artifact.

Third point on the cadence ladder: REBALANCE_EVERY=21 (weekly). Tests whether the worst-fold floor and the turnover floor can be cleared together, and at what cost to the Sharpe the trial-adjusted confidence floor needs.

Transparent baseline: equal-weight thirds long/short on causal market-residual momentum, beta window 270 bars, formation 63 bars, skip 1, cadence 21 phase 10 -- establishes the reference metric vector and calibrates the short-sleeve gross-PnL floor

Mandate ablation: identical book ranked on RAW trailing return (MARKET_REMOVAL=0) instead of the market residual -- does removing the causal market component earn its place, or is the residual book a beta ranking with extra steps

Can the two floors the baseline failed be fixed inside the lane: narrow the short sleeve to a fifth to make short_gross_pnl positive, lengthen cadence to 24 for turnover headroom, and see whether worst_fold_sharpe clears -0.25

Does a three-horizon composite residual score (42/63/126 bars derived from one constant, each cross-sectionally standardised) raise the bootstrap positive fraction toward the 0.9875 the confidence floor needs at eight trials, while keeping short_gross_pnl positive and turnover under 25x

Is the short sleeve at its useful width? Narrow SHORT_SLEEVE_FRACTION from 0.20 to 0.18 with everything else identical to trial #33, and read short_gross_pnl, the worst fold and the bootstrap positive fraction
Phase axis on the organiser's pipeline: the same composite residual book at rebalance phase 16 instead of 10, to measure how much of trial #33's vector is the phase offset rather than the mechanism

Declared neighbourhood sweep of the nominated composite market-residual book: FORMATION_BARS, REBALANCE_BARS and REBALANCE_PHASE each varied by about ten percent (phase by six offsets, since ten percent of phase 10 is one offset and does not explore the axis), seven points, per-metric median

Falsification battery on the nominated point: exact sign inversion plus the gross-edge placebo, to establish whether the residual-momentum edge is a mechanism or a construction artifact -- run for the record even though the neighbourhood median already fails the trial-adjusted confidence floor and this candidate will not be nominated

payload.purpose: Does an equal-weight cross-sectional composite of the four downside-risk characteristics (left-tail CVaR, semideviation, drawdown depth, recovery time) sorted into a beta-balanced long-low/short-high book clear the floors on the in-sample top-20?

THE MANDATED ABLATION: the identical book selecting on total realised volatility, with the downside and asymmetry content removed and nothing else changed - does downside risk do work plain volatility does not?

CONTROLS-OFF: the downside composite with its one control (the beta-balancing leg tilt) removed, so the sleeves take equal dollar shares - how much of the book is the risk sort and how much is the control?

TRANSPARENT BASELINE: rank the point-in-time top-20 on downside semideviation alone, equal dollar sleeves, no control - the simplest thing this lane can do, against which the composite and the control must earn their place.
SECOND REBALANCE HORIZON: the identical nominee at a fortnightly rather than a weekly cadence - is the result a property of the mechanism or of the holding period?
INDIVIDUAL CONTROL: the single-characteristic baseline with the beta-balancing tilt switched on, completing the 2x2 of {composite, single characteristic} x {tilt, no tilt}.
The declared section 7.2 sweep: seven points varying formation window (189/252/315), sleeve breadth (5/6/7) and rebalance phase (1/2/3) around the fixed nominee - is the result a plateau or a spike?

The section 7.1 battery on the nominated point: exact sign inversion (does shorting low-downside-risk and buying high-downside-risk also clear the core floors, which would make the edge a construction artifact?) plus the gross-edge shuffled-signal placebo.

organiser_corrections.team_06_note_3_is_outdated: the team reported that G ignores both sleeve-PnL floors. That was true of the pre-A5 formula and is no longer true: role_long_gross_pnl and role_short_gross_pnl are both in UNPRICED_FLOOR_SPECS, so a negative short sleeve costs 1/13 of the compliance factor -- verified at 0.9231 for their own ablation vector, about 4.5 G points at their G_core. Their ablation comparison was computed offline against a reimplementation that predates A5. The conclusion they drew from it is unaffected: the sleeve difference IS the nomination's justification, and A5 prices it.

team_07_notes.declined_by_the_team: a drawdown brake worth ~10 G on their own simulator, declined because it engages in only two episodes; and the best in-sample configuration found (cadence 3 phase 0), declined as a UTC-settlement-clock bet belonging to another lane.
team_07_notes.funding_lookahead_verification: 0 negatives in 201,036 rows of funding_time vs nominal boundary; smallest gap to the newest readable settlement 2.000h across 41 sampled decisions; a position opened at T pays the T+8h settlement while the freshest readable rate settled at T-8h.
team_07_notes.lane_premise_FALSIFIED_by_its_own_team: the mandate named the PROTECTION, not the carry, as the research question. The protection-on/off ablation (#68 vs #69, one constant changed) gives Sharpe 0.9744 vs 0.9779 -- the guard is worth MINUS 0.004 of Sharpe, and the worst-fold gap is inside phase-offset noise. Doubling the guard strength moves Sharpe by 0.009; pushed to a hard filter it is decisively harmful (Sharpe 0.848, worst fold -0.199, G 18.27). Six further stand-aside forms were all monotonically harmful.
team_07_notes.short_vol_shape_did_NOT_appear: the expected steady-then-cascade profile did not materialise: 4 of 4 folds positive at 2x (+0.371/+1.292/+0.528/+0.735), and the funding leg paid +3.5-7.5% in every fold across bull, bear and chop. The price leg carries all the variance.
team_07_notes.what_actually_carries_the_book: carry-to-risk sizing, a shared risk transform rather than lane alpha: controls-off drops Sharpe 0.974 -> 0.547 and G to 3.77. The team says so explicitly and nominates the guarded book because the guard is free and caps concentration, not because it earns.
team_07_notes.why_it_fails_mechanically: crowding and carry are +0.471 rank-correlated -- the danger signal and the carry signal are the same number, so standing aside when crowded is standing aside when paid. The team identified this as the structural reason rather than a tuning failure.

payload.purpose: PREREGISTRATION OF THE SLEEVE-COMBINATION RULE, recorded before any combined book of team-12 had been computed anywhere, offline or otherwise; the run itself is the transparent equal-weight long top-20 baseline control. THE RULE, VERBATIM: 'Inverse-volatility (naive risk-parity) sleeve weighting. At every decision boundary t, each sleeve k emits a weight vector over the eligible symbols normalised to unit gross (sum_i |w_k,i(t)| = 1). Sleeve k's contribution to the combined book is that unit-gross vector multiplied by 1/sigma_k(t), where sigma_k(t) is the sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of sleeve k's own past-only proxy return series over the most recent RISK_PARITY_BARS observations attributed to boundaries strictly before t. The proxy return attributed to boundary g is x_k(g) = sum_i w_k,i(g-1) * (close_i[g-1]/close_i[g-2] - 1), the sleeve's own unit-gross weight vector formed at the previous boundary applied to the close-to-close simple return of the bar that closed at g, with no costs, no funding and no leverage. Until RISK_PARITY_BARS such observations exist, or if sigma_k(t) is not finite and strictly positive, sleeve k receives the multiplier 1. The combined book is the plain sum of the scaled sleeve vectors, returned unnormalised; the evaluator's own unit-gross normalisation then applies. No other sleeve-level multiplier, tilt, cap, floor, sign flip, correlation adjustment or performance-conditioned term of any kind is applied, at any boundary, ever.' RISK_PARITY_BARS = 270 (90 days on the 8h grid), fixed a priori to match the organiser's own common-risk-unit lookback of 90 days per charter section 6. The four sleeves, fixed with the rule: CARRY (funding-crowding), TREND (time-series price persistence), LOWRISK (risk-characteristic selection), FLOW (aggressive taker-flow footprint). Prediction registered with the rule: if independent mechanisms diversify each other's drawdowns here, the equal-risk combination shows a LOWER maximum drawdown and a HIGHER worst-fold Sharpe than its own best single sleeve; if its drawdown merely sits between the sleeves', the sleeves shared a factor and diversification did nothing, and that is the result to report.

CONTROL, one of four sleeve-standalone ablations: what does the CARRY sleeve (cross-sectional rank of trailing 126-boundary mean funding rate, sign flipped) do on its own, so the preregistered ensemble can be compared against every component and against its best single component.
CONTROL, sleeve-standalone ablation: what does the TREND sleeve (per-coin time-series momentum over 45/90/135 boundaries, volatility-scaled, net exposure free) do on its own.
CONTROL, sleeve-standalone ablation: what does the LOWRISK sleeve (cross-sectional rank of trailing drawdown depth over 189/378/567 boundaries, sign flipped) do on its own.

CONTROL, sleeve-standalone ablation: what does the FLOW sleeve (cross-sectional rank of trailing taker-buy share of quote volume over 63/126 boundaries) do on its own; on the offline replica this is the best single sleeve and therefore the bar the ensemble has to clear.

CONTROL: the identical four sleeves at EQUAL NOTIONAL instead of the preregistered inverse-volatility weighting, so the record can separate what the combination RULE contributes from what merely owning these four sleeves contributes.

CONTROL, leave-one-out: the same preregistered rule applied to TREND, LOWRISK and FLOW with the weakest sleeve removed. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- the nominee keeps all four sleeves, because dropping one after seeing a combined result is re-weighting under another name and this lane forbids it; this trial exists so the certificate can state the cost of that discipline in points rather than assert it.

NOMINEE: the four-sleeve preregistered ensemble at the parameters journaled with the combination rule at sequence 121 -- inverse-volatility weighting over CARRY, TREND, LOWRISK and FLOW, cadence 6, phase 3, RISK_PARITY_BARS 270. Does combining four causally independent mechanisms at a-priori equal risk beat every one of them alone on drawdown and on fold consistency.

The declared 9-point neighbourhood of the frozen nominee, fixed before this declaration was written. The four coordinates are deliberately the ones most able to embarrass the result: the rebalance PHASE (charter section 9.1 makes phase a first-order axis for any cadence above one bar), RISK_PARITY_BARS (the preregistered combination rule's own parameter, so the sweep tests whether the answer depends on the exact sleeve weights rather than on the sleeves), and the formation horizons of the two cross-sectional sleeves that carry the most gross, FLOW and LOWRISK. The nominee is not moved by any of this; the score is the per-metric median across the nine points.

The mandatory battery on the nominated point: exact sign inversion (if flipping every emitted weight also clears the core floors the edge is a harness artifact and the candidate is disqualified) plus the eight-book gross-edge placebo. Registered expectation: the inversion should fail on annualised return alone, and the placebo exceedance should be near zero for the three cross-sectional sleeves but is structurally uninformative about the TREND sleeve, which makes no cross-sectional selection and therefore cannot be distinguished from a permutation of its own weight multiset.

CONTROL, leave-one-out on the STRONGEST sleeve: the same preregistered rule applied to CARRY, TREND and LOWRISK with FLOW deleted. This is the sharpest form of the lane's question -- with the single best component removed, does the COMBINATION still carry the book, or was the ensemble only ever its strongest member wearing a coat. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; the nominee keeps all four sleeves.
